goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann Instrumente und Konflikte der Umweltpolitik beschreiben.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native 16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Existing format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: Kommune, Bund and EU are illustrative governance levels linked by large bidirectional coordination arrows over a shared environmental space. No arrow claims a command hierarchy or a concrete legal competence.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px all three labels and both bidirectional arrows are identifiable without reading documents.
actualInspection.desktop: 680 px shows discussion at each level and a shared river as the environmental subject.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: Hand-held sheets are blank and tablets face users; no imposed viewer-readable content from the wrong actor perspective.
actualInspection.style: Friendly approachable comic raster, clear broad colors, large conceptual objects; no photorealistic or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: Länder are not shown. The current goal does not require an exhaustive federal organigram; use this as a selected coordination illustration, not a complete enumeration of German environmental competences.
goalTextStatus: Current German competence unchanged in the E2 bilingual candidate; this image review does not attest the positive-evidence profile or bilingual description gate.
